evidence: At least one CI workflow generates build provenance or signed attestations tying artifacts to the commit that produced them
expected_output: One observation row with workflow_count and provenance_step_count

assertions.description: CI exists — provenance without a pipeline is not possible.
Some workflow step generates provenance or attestations (slsa-github-generator, attest-build-provenance, cosign, --provenance).

caveats: Detects the configuration, not the attestations themselves — verifying published attestations against a registry is appliance-phase work.
